name: TOLINS TYRES LIMITED
summary: Tolins Tyres Limited manufactures and sells tires and tread rubber in India. It offers two-wheeler, three-wheeler, light commercial vehicle, and agricultural tires; precured tread rubber; and retreading products, including bonding gum, curing bags, camel back - conventional rubber, vulcanizing solutions, etc. The company also exports its products to 40 countries, including the Middle East, East Africa, Jordan, Kenya, and Egypt. Tolins Tyres Limited was founded in 1982 and is based in Aluva, India.
